d: The Spurs defeated the Clippers, 124-112 tonight in San Antonio. Victor Wembanyama contributed a team-high 32 points to go with 11 rebounds 3 assists and 2 three pointers, with Stephon Castle of the Spurs adding an additional 21 points (7-12 FG, 2-4 3P) in the game. Brook Lopez finished with a team-high 23 points along with 5 three pointers for the Clippers in the losing effort. The Spurs improve their record to 13-3 with the win, while the Clippers fall to 4-10 for the season.
